profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Microsoft | Harvard 2020
profile.summary:
Harvard grad ‘20. Software Engineer at Microsoft working on Teams.
Previous CTO of "Carbin AI" and "Leah Wellness". Highly experienced in full-stack development, UX/UI development, machine learning, and cyber security.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Web Defense
positions.description:
•	Worked in Web Defense, with a key emphasis on utilizing Machine Learning to effectively combat and
mitigate phishing attempts.
•	Built the first precrime machine learning model, which predicts a web threat before it actually occurs, using lexicographical patterns in the URL. Resulting in 96.23% Precision and 91.94% Recall
•	Implemented AI Explainability and partnered with Microsoft Research to deliver inference + explanations in 7ms/verdict.
•	Experimented with different classifiers and evaluated their performance based on objective metrics such as AUC, accuracy, precision, recall, and F1.
•	Knowledgeable in CI/CD practices, automating model deployment, and orchestrating model workflows.

positions.title: Chief Technology Officer (Carbin AI)
positions.description:
•	Developed and designed an iOS app that uses the phone’s sensors to analyze the quality of the roads the users drive on. With over 100,000 miles of data, “Carbin” is available on App Store and Play Store.
•	Managed the Android software engineering team in Palestine.
•	Designed the backend structure on Firebase and AWS real-time databases.
•	Developed robust solutions to meet requirements for functionality, scalability and performance.
•	Implemented data storage solutions, network interruption handling and sending files to the backend without any data loss.
•	Programmed and designed two websites, one for app presentation and one for rendering analyzed data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed iOS applications and websites using React Native and React JS for a diverse range of global clients.
•	Translated designer mock-ups and wireframes into high-quality frontend code to ensure seamless user experience.
•	Designed and implemented the official website of the company to reflect its brand identity and attract potential customers.
•	Evaluated project specifications to design and deploy effective technological solutions that surpassed client expectations.
•	Leveraged GraphQL queries and mutations to establish seamless communication between frontend and backend databases.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed a debugging tool using C# to analyze LOG files.
•	Communicated weekly reports and technical expertise to team members and architects.

projects.title: Genyses
projects.description: Designed and developed an interactive NFT website featuring animated 3D renders of planets and spaceships.
